name: Smithsonian Open Access
tagline: Search Smithsonian museum collections and open-access media.
description: Public API for searching Smithsonian museum collections and open-access media across SI units. Developers can query object metadata, images, and related resources from the Smithsonian Institution's digitized collections.

auth.details: API key required; obtain via self-serve registration on the Smithsonian Open Access developer portal.

use_cases: search Smithsonian museum object metadata by keyword
retrieve open-access images and media for a collection object
look up records across Smithsonian units (museums, archives, libraries)
fetch structured collection data for education or research apps
